english: Defeat the Skeleton King on floor 20.
Defeat the Ghost Queen on floor 20.
Defeat the Dark Knight on floor 40.
Defeat the Corrupted Ocean Goddess on floor 60.
schinese: 击败第60层的腐化海洋女神。
首次赢得一场远征战斗。

english: Enter a boss battle with at least two heroes and win with only one surviving.
schinese: 至少两名角色参战，仅剩一名角色存活时赢得Boss战。

english: Win a boss battle with all three heroes alive.
schinese: 三名角色全部存活，赢得一场Boss战。

english: Successfully respond to three different enemy attack cards in one turn.
schinese: 同一回合成功应对三张不同的敌方攻击牌。

english: Enter a boss battle with at least three consumables and win without using any.
schinese: 携带至少三个消耗品，且不使用任何消耗品，赢得一场Boss战。

english: Defeat at least three enemies with poison damage in one battle.
schinese: 同一场战斗中，让中毒伤害击败至少三名敌人。

english: Defeat an enemy while it is both poisoned and burning.
schinese: 击败一名同时拥有中毒和灼烧的敌人。

english: Defeat at least three enemies with a single attack card.
schinese: 使用一张攻击牌击败至少三名敌人。

english: Defeat at least one front-row enemy and one back-row enemy in the same turn.
schinese: 同一回合内，击败至少一名前排敌人和一名后排敌人。

english: Have all three heroes successfully respond to an enemy attack, then win the battle.
schinese: 三名角色各成功应对至少一次敌方攻击，并赢得该场战斗。

english: Keep the same Inherit card in hand through three consecutive turn ends, then play it.
schinese: 让同一张继承牌连续跨过三个回合结束仍留在手中，随后使用它。

english: Evolve a relic for the first time.
schinese: 首次完成一次遗物进化。
首次成功刻印一张橙色卡牌。

english: Own at least 30 different cards in your collection.
schinese: 卡牌收藏中拥有至少30种不同的卡牌。

english: Own at least five different orange-rarity cards in your collection.
schinese: 卡牌收藏中拥有至少五种不同的橙色卡牌。

english: Upgrade an upgradable card to its maximum level.
schinese: 将一张可升级卡牌提升至其最高等级。

english: Successfully engrave five cards in total.
schinese: 累计成功刻印五张卡牌。

english: Raise one hero to the maximum camp level.
schinese: 将任意一名角色的局外等级提升至满级。

english: Raise all six heroes to the maximum camp level.
schinese: 将六名角色的局外等级全部提升至满级。
